title: IDN : Update dissector to latest Draft (2021)
description: Alongside some minor changes this Update mostly consists of the addition of Audio Sample dissection. For more information on the protocol see https://www.ilda.com/technical.htm

notes.body: changed title from **Update{-d-} dissector to latest Draft {-of idn from -}2021** to **{+IDN : +}Update dissector to latest Draft {+(+}2021{+)+}**
All value_strings need to end with an {0, NULL} tuple.

The commit check finds many issues in this code. This is what needs to be done:

2. Fix [code issues](https://gitlab.com/lich1/wireshark/-/jobs/9176297129), using tools in tools directory

@RomanLichnock you need to rebase and not merge with upstream
Oh, and any MR can't come from a personal master branch. It must be from a separate branch.

I tried to "move this along", by just rebasing it onto latest master (and resolving conflicts), but how do I push the changes to this MR (keeping this history and Roman as the author)?  I haven't figured out how to do that in gitlab, because I don't want this coming from my fork (but I thought I had permissions to update this MR)

Hi Michael,

You can look on the top the "Code" button with option

but for this MR, we need to close and recreate using an other branch name

This patch needed some updates because it failed code review and testing with existing IDN samples (#16707).
Would be great if there was a sample with the new audio dissection, but I've at least guaranteed it doesn't break older dissection.
But I created a new MR for this functionality (!19705 ) and will close this one.
